data.narrative:
Vyriy Drone is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $4M+ in M&A activity as of 2025. The broader peer universe comprises 10 comparable firms (2 public, 8 private), including later-stage players such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, though no direct same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with sufficient data density exist within the narrow peer set.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using the $4M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $5M. The Peer-Median method does not meet the minimum threshold of three datapoints; while 23 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security, filtering for stage alignment and valuation tier produces insufficient observations to support a reliable median benchmark without introducing significant cross-sector noise.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $4M to $6M, with a median point of $5M, derived solely from stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the lack of narrow-peer multiples to validate the single-method result and the reliance on historical capital raised as a valuation proxy rather than revenue or profitability metrics. Additional revenue, profitability, or customer concentration data would strengthen conviction in this range.
